content:
Miranda: Quick sync — need final changelog URL, docs anchor, webinar slide deck link, and inbound lead-routing plan for the Tuesday release. Can we lock timings today? @Ethan FYI on canary windows. :calendar:

Samir: I can own the inbound routing mapping. What's the expected traffic spike? rough numbers help decide if we need parallel webhooks.

Ethan: Canary plan: start 09:30 PST with 10% traffic, ramp to 50% at 09:45 if no errors, full at 10:15. Keeping a hot fallback to model-v1-quant. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4821. If monitoring sees >5% 5xx in 5m we rollback.

Priya: Docs are staged at /docs/release/2026-03-inference. I'll add an anchor to the changelog section: /docs/release/2026-03-inference#changelog. Final publish scheduled 09:20 PST (before canary).

Jordan: Support playbook — added a short runbook in Zendesk ticket template #832. Key notes: known degradations (latency bump with long context), how to escalate to eng-oncall, and canned responses for customers.

Miranda: Perfect. Samir can you paste the inbound routing mapping when you have it? We'll need: GTM landing page -> SFDC leadflow, webinar signups -> special nurture tag, benchmarks demo signups -> SDR queue.

Samir: Draft mapping below, please review:
- /release-preview -> Campaign: release-2026-03, SFDC: Lead.Source=website
- /benchmarks -> Campaign: bench-deck, SFDC: Lead.Owner=sd-team
- /webinar-register -> Campaign: webinar-march, Add tag: webinar-march-attendee
I can wire webhooks; ETA 2h.

Ethan: One more config note for ops: please update routing policy to prefer west-coast region during rollout (to keep latency consistent). Config snippet for infra team:
```
routing_policy:
  preferred_region: us-west-2
  fallback: global
  canary_fraction: 0.1
```

Priya: Slide deck link: https://drive.redwood.com/drive/folders/1X-demo-deck-rev3 — will remove speaker notes before publish. Also adding a short benchmark blurb for marketing copy.

release-bot: deploy scheduled by @Ethan for 2026-03-17 09:30:00 PST — canary start. CI checks passed. :rocket:

Miranda: Thanks all. Final checklist for today (I'll tick off in a minute):
- [ ] publish docs anchor (Priya 09:20)
- [ ] inbound routing webhooks (Samir +2h)
- [ ] support runbook published (Jordan done)
- [ ] canary + rollback policy (Ethan done)
- [ ] social + benchmark copy ready (Miranda / marketing)

Any last blockers? If not, I'll push the comms schedule to shared calendar and create the release-channel 30m before canary. :white_check_mark:

Ethan: No blockers from eng. If traffic looks higher than expected we'll throttle at the LB layer and keep the fallback model live.

Samir: Routing webhooks done, pasted into shared doc: https://docs.redwood.com/ops/release-2026-03-routing. I updated SFDC mappings and added the nurture flows.

Miranda: Great — I'll post the final changelog link and the keynote copy in 20m. Thanks everyone! :tada:
